0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Boston Celtics visit the Detroit Pistons, and Boston's Neemias Queta, Payton Pritchard, and Sam Hauser are all listed as day-to-day with rest, each a game-time decision. Last season the Celtics lost 1-3 to Detroit, and their most recent meeting ended in a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Celtics a 50% chance to win.
